scientific_integrity: The planar mask-zero cosets and the dilation-union zero-set formula are established prior tools, explicitly attributed. New claims concern real Taylor order, local phase index, and exact/asymptotic order-and-charge incidences. The Deng–Lau (2015) full text was unavailable; independent audit and publication-priority confirmation have not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Equal-weight dyadic planar three-map Sierpinski measure only; no assertion of zero structure for other weights/scalings, complex-frequency zero varieties, or published priority. Numerical computations supplement rather than prove all-radius and infinite-product claims.
title: Zero multiplicities and phase indices of the Sierpinski-gasket Fourier transform
